title: This Free Local AI Agent Outperformed Hermes
description:
Free beats paid. Local beats cloud. And a smarter loop just beat a bigger name — same model, same benchmark, less than half the time.

Meet Atomic Agent: opens your browser, edits your files, runs approved commands, remembers context — all on your own machine, zero API fees.

Turns out the agent loop matters more than model size.
